## Component / task
Owner/branch: firmware/, sender/, receiver/, or coordinated integration/.

## Result
Describe the requested behavior and changed files. Keep ordinary PRs inside one component. Shared interface changes: state compatibility impact and affected owners.

## Verification
Record component checks, shared checks and real device/offline tests actually run. Mark unavailable tests and pending Gemini findings honestly. Link your component handoff; do not edit another person's task file.

## Dependencies / contract
Record manifest+lock/runtime or artifact changes. Shared changes must regenerate constants and all consumer pins together. Do not claim generated fixtures prove physical transfer or model readiness.
